## ✨ Features

### 🔒 Privacy & Sovereignty

 100% Local Storage: All memories, tasks, and conversations live in a SQLite database on your device.
 Your Keys, Your Model: Bring your own OpenAI/Deepgram keys. No middleman servers. Deepgram gives $200 free credit on signup!
 Offline Capable: Use local Whisper models to transcribe audio without an internet connection.
 Export All Data: Export your entire database as JSON anytime.
 iCloud Backup: Optional sync across your devices.

### 🧠 Advanced AI

 Memories: Automatically extracts important facts. Edit or add memories manually by selecting text.
 Actionable Tasks: Detects promises and to-dos with scheduled local notifications.
 Hold-to-Ask: Hold the Omi button to chat with your AI assistant in real-time.

### ⚡️ Modern Hardware Integration [...] ## 🗺 Roadmap

 Core: BLE Audio, Live Transcription, Database
 AI: Memories, Tasks, Local Notifications
 Hardware: Battery, Haptics, Device Info
 v2.1.0: Edit Memories, Search, Export, Stats, Notification Settings
 Integrations: Google Calendar, Notion, Apple Reminders

# Omi Local (Omibutfree)

The Open Source, Privacy-First Companion for Omi Devices.

Flutter Platform License Version

Features • Installation • Architecture • Roadmap

## 🚀 Overview

Omi Local is a fully functioning, self-hosted alternative to the official Omi app. It is designed for users who want full control over their data, zero monthly subscriptions, and a powerful local-first AI experience.

It connects directly to your Omi hardware (Friend/DevKit) via Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and processes audio entirely on your terms—whether that's using local Whisper models on your iPhone or your own private API keys for Cloud transcription.

## FAQ

What is the best alternative to Omi?  
It depends on why you are switching. Legend One is the closest always-on alternative and needs no setup, at $499 a year. Bee Frontier is the cheapest at $74.99. The Plaud NotePin S at $179 is the best choice for planned recording.

Is there an always-on alternative to Omi?  
Yes, Legend One. It captures all day without a button press. Bee Frontier now starts and stops with a button, so it is no longer always on.

Is Omi free to use?  
Omi's free plan includes unlimited on-phone transcription and 300 cloud minutes a month. Omi Pro costs $29.99 a month or $269.91 a year, as checked on 18 November 2026. [...] Start with the reason you are leaving Omi.

If you want the same always-on capture with less setup and no audio kept in your account, Legend One is the alternative, at a much higher price. If you want to spend less, Bee Frontier is $74.99, with a button. If you have realized your important conversations are planned, a NotePin S or Pocket will cost less over time and keep the recording. That last question is the one that matters most, and we cover it in always-on or press-to-record.

For the whole category in one table, see the comparison page or Best AI Pendant 2026. Three-year costs are in AI pendant subscription costs.

## FAQ [...] The best Omi alternatives in 2026 are Legend One ($499, first year of membership included) if you want always-on capture that needs no setup, Bee Frontier ($74.99) if you want to spend less, and the Plaud NotePin S ($179) if you would rather press record for planned conversations. Pocket ($129) and soundcore Work ($159) are worth a look for recording on purpose. Omi itself is still a good buy at $129 if you like open-source tools.

Every price below was checked at the maker's own site on 18 November 2026. Prices are USD.
